title: Self-paced Dart programming exercise series
summary: Students solve 64 browser-based Dart exercises in a self-paced online course with automated tests and exercise-specific feedback. They can request human help after a failed submission; researchers later tested LLM responses on 15 high-request exercises without exposing those responses to students.

sources.title: Exploring the Responses of Large Language Models to Beginner Programmers’ Help Requests
sources.evidence_quote: The exercises are automatically assessed, the platform provides exercise-specific feedback, and there is no limit on the number of submissions.
